# Gaffa UI Architecture & Components

> Dynasty fantasy football platform for the Premier League.
> Calm, tactile, data-dense broadsheet sports journal crossed with high-performance trading platform.

## Design Tokens & Philosophy
- Theme: Cream ground (`#F8F4EC`), deep forest green chrome (`#185B37`), green accent ramp (`--color-accent`: `#0C6D3E`). Both light and dark themes pass WCAG AA.
- Typography: Newsreader serif (`--font-serif`) for titles/scores, Archivo Narrow (`--font-condensed`) for labels/badges/buttons, Hanken Grotesk (`--font-sans`) for body, JetBrains Mono (`--font-mono`) for tickers/stopwatches.
- Surfaces: Border XOR shadow, declared once. No ghost cards. No white panels floating on cream ground without bounded context.
- Mobile: First-class touch target (44px min). Modals become bottom sheets on `<640px` with `dvh` and safe area insets.

## UI Primitives (`@/components/ui`)
Use these primitives rather than authoring bespoke CSS modules for common controls:

- `Button` (`@/components/ui`): Archivo Narrow, Title Case labels, Emil Kowalski press scale (`--press-scale: 0.97`), loading spinner, lead/tail icons. Variants: `primary`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `danger`. Sizes: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Supports `href` (polymorphic).
- `ResponsiveModal` (`@/components/ui`): Desktop centered dialog (`>640px`) with Newsreader serif title, auto-converting to bottom drawer on mobile (`<=640px`) with swipe handle and safe-area padding. Scrim mousedown protection, Escape stack handling, body scroll locking.
- `SegmentedControl` (`@/components/ui`): Tablist view switcher with arrow-key keyboard navigation and Archivo Narrow typography.
- `SimpleSelect` (`@/components/ui`): Styled desktop select falling back to native mobile OS picker on touch.
- `Kbd` (`@/components/ui`): Shortcut keycap hints. Affordances must use infinitive purpose ("Enter to open") or direct imperatives ("Press Enter to open").
- `Icon` (`@/components/ui`): Inline SVG editorial icon set.
- `NavigationLink` (`@/components/ui`): TopBar loading-aware Next.js link.

## Binding UI Rules
1. Headings, section titles, and action buttons are Title Case ("Save Lineup", not "Save lineup").
2. No eyebrow labels / kickers above titles.
3. "Club Balance", never "FAAB".
4. Elevation is border XOR shadow (never declare both on a card or panel).
5. No coloured accent bars on container edges (no left stripes or top colored rules).
6. Keys, tools, and UI objects do not perform actions (no inanimate agency: "Enter to open", never "Enter opens it").
